name: Thetanuts zero-supply residual-asset share pricing
summary: deposit() used a one-to-one initialization rate whenever totalSupply was zero even though the vault retained WBTC, so the attacker minted all new shares with a two-satoshi seed and a 4.68 WBTC deposit, then redeemed those shares for the deposit plus the unowned residual balance.

loss.notes: Gross loss is the exact pre-existing WBTC captured from the vault. The helper deposited 4.68000002 WBTC, withdrew 4.83177164 WBTC, repaid the separate 10 WBTC flash loan, and transferred the 0.15177162 WBTC difference to the attacker EOA. This transaction-level amount supersedes the larger reported estimates that are not supported by its token flows. WBTC is valued at DefiLlama's nearest price at or before the incident.

ageReset.description: The defect-bearing vault runtime was created directly in this transaction and remained byte-identical through the pre-exploit block; the exploit trace executes it directly without a target-originated delegatecall.

sources.note: Reviewed the exploit receipt and full call trace, commit-pinned reproduction, public incident account, deployment receipt, historical runtime, and WBTC transfer ledger. Before the exploit the vault held WBTC while totalSupply was zero. Helper 0xe26f5a496db55de2a69bdc4eef023927b3c2a209 deposits 2 satoshis for one share, deposits another 468,000,000 satoshis for 468,000,000 shares, burns 468,000,001 shares through initWithdraw(), and receives 483,177,164 satoshis. After repaying the 10 WBTC Morpho flash loan it transfers exactly 15,177,162 satoshis to the attacker EOA. The defect-bearing address is a direct 16,097-byte runtime created at block 14857003, transaction index 98. Its hash is 0xf240ab4156209d9925b35c32b3bbf95f1870577a617206be4c8105a212db7fa5 at deployment and pre-exploit block 24923218, and the exploit trace contains no target-originated DELEGATECALL. Code age is 123,018,968 seconds.
